modal.help_s1b: Hindura Amadrive ya volume zose, + Ongeramo idosiye kongeramo, x ikuraho rimwe, cyangwa unyuze inzira zitandukanijwe na `;` muri Edit. Guhindura amatabo guhindura amadosiye.
modal.help_s2b: Izina, Regex (Rust syntax), Fuzzy, Ibirimo bya dosiye, Glob (*.rs), Icyaricyose (OR) / Nta na kimwe (NOT), ingano (byte cyangwa 10M/1G), amatariki (YYYY-MM-DD), urutonde rwo gusimba rwa Exclude, Amayagurwa cyangwa group chips (simbuza, kanda nanone gusiba; Manage ihindura iyihariye), Irengagiza case, Erekana ibihishe.
modal.help_s3b: Buto nini ya Scan & search cyangwa Enter. Refresh isubiramo ibungabunga ihitamo. Live yikora ubwayo guhindura (bibuzwa by default). Ugushaka kw'ubusa ntukora — shyira * muri Glob kuri byose.
modal.help_s4b: Imitwe mito itondeka, Go isimbutsa amapaji, checkboxes zigaburira Copy paths / Move / Delete na exports za CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Ugushaka kwabitswe na Recent snapshots bisubiza akayunguruzo yose harimo amadosiye, OR/NOT, n'ibihishe.
modal.help_keys_body: Enter ishaka · Esc ikuraho focus / ifunga dialogs · ↑/↓ yimura ihitamo · Space igenza umurongo · Tab yimura hagati y'ibigenzura.
